items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: He was Rose Murphy's first husband... I don't remember Pickens first name, but he was a tall, lanky guy and he was a marvelous piano player.

ctx.x: The Daniel Brothers Trio and you worked for them.

And when they came and got me to work with them when Picket -- I can't think of his first name -- Pickens, Pickens was a tall, slender guy, marvelous piano player, from New York. He was Rose Murphy's first husband, and he worked with these guys, with the Daniel Brothers, at the Club Royal, and when he took sick, they came to get me to work with them. I wasn't doing anything at that particular time.
I think I had just closed a job and they wanted me to work with them until Pickens got better. So I went on to work with them.
